outcome: mode of birth (caesarean sections, spontaneous deliveries)
cohort: The study included women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) divided into two groups: one receiving care during the COVID-19 pandemic (telemedicine group) and another receiving care in the pre-pandemic period.
finding: The use of telemedicine tools for GDM management during the COVID-19 pandemic did not significantly impact diabetes management or pregnancy outcomes compared to pre-pandemic care.
mod_finding: The number of caesarean sections and spontaneous deliveries was similar in both the pandemic (telemedicine) and pre-pandemic groups.
